plan.text:
OBJECTIVE: maximise bank balance by day 365 (start €1,500).
CONSTRAINTS: spot fee €12/day network. Never let balance < €300 (~25 days fees). >10 consecutive unpaid days ends business.
TARGETS: D1-30 stock all 6 machines with 3-5 products each; break even by ~day 30; grow weekly sales; keep stockouts low.

rules.text:
- NEVER put wait_for_next_day in the same batch as other actions, and never call it twice in a row. Two double-waits (D341->343, D353->355) skipped loading days. After each wait, read the day in the result before acting.
- Trips are the bottleneck. Stock sells out in 2-4 days. Order snacks every ~4 days, timed so arrivals land before slots run dry.
- Revenue per trip (full slot): nuts ~36, gummy ~32, dropjes ~29, crisps ~30, latte ~28, stroop/choco ~27, energy ~25, cola ~20, sparkling ~18.
- Check get_machine_inventory before loads.
- Zuidas min subtotal €75.
- Pay complaints in full (CMP-025..031 paid; reputation 1.00).
